turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided Owen gets a zero, and why did he find out on his phone?
Before anything else: I entered the zero before I called you. That broke procedure 4.2, and I am sorry Owen found out on his phone.
Okay. Now tell me what the zero is based on.
Here is the version history. Created Wednesday, October 28, 11:31 PM, title only. At 11:52 PM, 612 words in one edit. At 11:58 PM, 794 more. No earlier drafts. Turn the screen and read it yourself.
11:31, 11:52, 11:58, written down. He could have drafted it somewhere else and pasted it in. Was Owen heard before you decided?
If he drafted it somewhere else, that file has its own dates. Bring it and I will look at it with you. Until then, this is the only history there is.
Fine. You didn't answer me, Hale: was Owen heard before the zero went in? And whatever happens next, this stays off his record and it stays between us and him.
Second: the essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile. Here is the whole play on my screen. Search every edition you like; the line is not in Hamlet.
Turn it here, I'll search it myself. A seventeen-year-old misquoting Shakespeare is a citation error, not proof of anything. And you've now skipped my question twice: was Owen heard?
It is not a misremembered line. There is no line in the play close to it. Search the word exile yourself.
Exile. Nothing close. So what are you putting on the table, and how does it keep Owen out of the hallway gossip and off his record?
Third: his in-class writing from September 24. 380 words in 40 minutes, comma splices, no quotations. The essay has nine quotations cited by act, scene and line. Here are both, side by side.

Forty minutes in a classroom against a take-home with a week to work on it; any kid writes better with time and a copy of the play open. That one's the weakest thing you've shown me. I asked what you're proposing, and you answered with a third exhibit.

Under procedure 4.4 this is a first concern. A supervised rewrite, private, not in front of his class. If it shows the learning, its mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. I will put that in writing tonight.

That's 4.4, private, in writing tonight. Owen does the rewrite to put this behind him, not because of anything in that history. The email says the zero comes off, nothing goes on file, and the new mark is entered well before his December 1 applications, with a date for the rewrite.
Will he do it?
He'll do it. You send the date and the room, and I'll have him there.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You agreed today that Owen will complete a private supervised rewrite under procedure 4.4, that its mark replaces the zero, and that nothing goes on his record. I still expect a date and a room for the rewrite, and the new mark entered before his December 1 applications. I expect that confirmation in writing tonight, as you said.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: The last position, agreeing to a private supervised rewrite whose mark replaces the zero with nothing on his record; she still wants your written confirmation tonight, a date for the rewrite, and the new mark in before December 1, and that is the fair outcome under procedure 4.4.
What moved her: Showing a quotation she could search for herself and find missing from the play, because her misquoting defence collapsed under a check she made herself.
What cost ground: Leaving her question about whether Owen was heard before the zero unanswered three times, which made her sharper about your process, though it did not move her backward.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history placed the whole essay between 11:31 and 11:58 PM on October 28, right on that kind of late night before the due date; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Right after owning the breach of procedure 4.2, answer plainly whether you spoke with Owen before entering the zero, before she has to ask a second time.
